mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate indicates easy monetary policy, boosting equity markets through lower discount rates.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not higher when FEDFUNDS is low (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment rate signals economic strength, leading to positive S&P returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns do not follow low UNRATE (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts indicate strong demand, boosting economic growth and S&P returns.
failure_condition: Returns are not positive when HOUST exceeds 1100 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth signals increased supply, leading to positive S&P returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns do not follow INDPRO growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment combined with employment growth indicates a strong labor market, boosting S&P returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns do not follow when UNRATE is low and PAYEMS rises (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rate in a tightening cycle may lead to negative S&P returns.
failure_condition: Negative returns do not follow when FEDFUNDS rises (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth with stable inflation indicates healthy demand, leading to positive S&P returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns do not follow GDPC1 growth with stable CPIAUCSL (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising real federal spending signals increased demand, boosting S&P returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns do not follow RSAFS increase (t-test p > 0.05).
